claim: Parameterizes the 3D world-space ray through a 2D image pixel using camera intrinsics K, rotation R, translation t, and depth parameter lambda; used to convert depth estimation into ground-plane projection estimation for sports-scene annotation.
Solves for the depth parameter lambda at which the camera ray intersects the court ground plane Z=0, yielding the ball's ground projection point.

Applies a similarity transform centered at the camera center C with scale factor s to re-align a 3D mesh after depth correction, rescaling the mesh along camera rays without distorting its proportions.
Defines the relative focal-length error metrics e_{f_x} and e_{f_y} used to evaluate estimated camera intrinsics against ground truth.
Defines Threshold Mean Relative Accuracy (T-MRA), averaging indicator accuracy over ten confidence thresholds theta for distance and localization answers.
